entries.title: Jeremiah 10:1
segments: Hear the word which the LORD speaks to you, O house of Israel.

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:2
segments: So says the LORD, Do not learn the way of the nations, and do not be terrified at the signs of the heavens; for the nations are terrified at them.

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:3
segments: For the customs of the people [are] vain; for one cuts a tree out of the forest with the axe, the work of the hands of the workman.

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:4
segments: They adorn it with silver and with gold; they fasten it with nails and hammers, so that it will not wobble.

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:5
segments: They [are] like a rounded post, and they cannot speak. They must surely be lifted, because they cannot walk. Do not be afraid of them; for they cannot do evil nor good, for it is not in them.

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:6
segments: [There is] none like You, O LORD; You [are] great, and Your name [is] great in might.

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:7
segments: Who would not fear You, O King of nations? For fear belongs to You, because among all the wise men of the nations, and in all their kingdoms, [there is] none like You.

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:8
segments: But they are all at once foolish and animal-like; the tree [is] an example of vanities.

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:9
segments: Silver beaten into plates is brought from Tarshish, and gold from Uphaz, the work of the workman, and of the hands of the goldsmith. Violet and purple [is] their clothing; they [are] all the work of skillful ones.

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:10
segments: But the LORD [is] the true God, He [is] the living God, and the everlasting King. At His wrath the earth shall tremble, and the nations shall not be able to stand His fury.

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:11
segments: So you shall say to them, The gods who have not made the heavens and the earth, they shall perish from the earth and from under these heavens.

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:12
segments: He has made the earth by His power; He has established the world by His wisdom, and has stretched out the heavens by His judgment.

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:13
segments: When He utters His voice, [there is] a noise of many waters in the heavens. He causes the vapors to ascend from the ends of the earth; He makes lightnings with rain, and brings forth the wind out of His treasures.

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:14
segments: Every man is stupid for [lack of] knowledge; every refiner is put to shame by the graven image; for his molten image is a lie, and no breath is in them.

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:15
segments: They [are] vanity, the work of delusion; in the time of their judgment they shall perish.

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:16
segments: The Portion of Jacob [is] not like them; for He [is] the Maker of all things; and Israel [is] the rod of His inheritance. The LORD of hosts [is] His name.

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:17
segments: Gather up your bundle from the ground, you who live under the siege.

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:18
segments: For so says the LORD, Behold, I will sling out the people of the land at this time, and will distress them, so that they may find [Me].

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:19
segments: Woe [to] me for my breaking! My wound is grievous; but I said, Truly this [is] a malady, and I must bear it.

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:20
segments: My tabernacle is ravaged, and all my cords are broken; My sons went away from me, and they [are] not. [There is] none to stretch out My tabernacle any more, and to set up My curtains.

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:21
segments: For the pastors have become stupid, and have not sought the LORD, therefore they shall not be blessed, and all their flocks shall be scattered.

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:22
segments: Behold, the noise of the rumor has come, and a great commotion out of the north country, to make the cities of Judah a desolation, a den of jackals.

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:23
segments: O LORD, I know that the way of man does not [belong] to man; [it is] not in man who walks to direct his steps.

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:24
segments: O LORD, correct me, but with judgment; not in Your anger, lest You bring me to nothing.

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:25
segments: Pour out Your fury on the nations who do not know You, and on the families who do not call on Your name; for they have eaten up Jacob and have devoured him, and have destroyed him, and have made his dwelling desolate.
